purpose: Concept mockups, not captured game data or implemented UI
notes: Detailed world graphics in the generated concepts are an aspirational illustration, not proof of native chart resolution. All figures are illustrative.
shared_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity full screen desktop application UI concept, aspect ratio 4:3 designed for 1152x864. Flat straight-on screen image only, no physical monitor, no perspective, no desktop wallpaper. App FACTORY CONTROL, Russian interface for an experienced Factorio player on a second monitor. Dense practical retro industrial dispatch terminal, near-black blue background #020c12, extremely fine dark cyan panel outlines, luminous ivory condensed Cyrillic slab serif monospace headings and readable bright cyan, green numbers, amber warning and red critical accents. Restrained subtle CRT phosphor glow ONLY, razor sharp readable text, no scanlines, no curvature, no blur, no chromatic fringes. Header consistent across screens: left small gear and FACTORY CONTROL, next green indicator ОНЛАЙН, right compact gear settings, АТАКА indicator, sound icon, fullscreen icon. Bottom compact tabs ОБЗ ЭНРГ ПРЗВ ЛОГ НАУК РЕС ПРГ ПОДКЛ. No explanatory technical footnotes, no OS branding, no FPS labels. Main content is spatial diagnosis on a genuinely detailed recognizable Factorio M-style 2D cartographic map, with ochre green terrain, irregular dark blue lakes, colored ore patches, extremely dense regular industrial building footprints in cyan and brown, branching conveyor corridors, thin rail loops, electrical infrastructure, small recipe/item icons when close. NO perspective or isometric 3D buildings, NO generic node network graph, NO sci-fi radar circles. Map is a layered detailed top-down plan of a real sprawling organized megabase. Realistic spacing and industrial blocks, good contrast between map and selected problem markers. Treat all numbers as illustrative mockup data.

Left 30% width persistent problem list with compact rows/cards, filters Все Критические Новые. Selected amber row НЕДОСТАТОК СЫРЬЯ, Плавка железа · 18 печей, 3 мин, -24% выпуска, tiny sparkline. Other rows ДЕФИЦИТ ЭНЕРГИИ, ЗАДЕРЖКА ДОСТАВКИ, ИСТОЩЕНИЕ МЕСТОРОЖДЕНИЯ. images.scene_prompt: Screen 3: same app diagnostic drill-down in a different selected issue. Title ЭНЕРГОСНАБЖЕНИЕ · ВОСТОЧНЫЙ СЕКТОР. Left 30% panel same list, selected red issue ДЕФИЦИТ ЭНЕРГИИ, Восточный сектор · 42 машины, below detail cards Обеспечение 68%, Длительность 1 мин 24 с, Затронуто 42 машины and compact 5-minute green/cyan history graph with a clear falling amber supply line. Map legend tiny bottom Производство / Потребители / Проблема. Map zoom controls + and -. Bottom panel ПОДТВЕРЖДЕНО: машины получают недостаточно энергии. Next line ПРОВЕРИТЬ: выработку и соединения электросети. Button ПОКАЗАТЬ СЕТЬ. Distinguish actual insufficient energy from unproven cause. No alarm modal, colors remain balanced, clear map.
